title: eludite.browser.upload input
description: Set the files of a file input (`<input type=file>`, by `ref` from eludite.browser.read_page or find) to existing files on disk (DOM.setFileInputFiles), as choosing them in the file dialog would; the page gets `input` and `change` events. Several files need an input with `multiple`. The page sees each file's name, size and content. Permission class execute for files in the workspace folder; a file outside it makes the call dangerous, which prompts (ADR-0009). Next: eludite.browser.input to click the upload button, eludite.browser.wait for the page to react.
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous when a path is outside the workspace folder.

ref.description: The file input: a ref (`e1`, `e2`, ...) from eludite.browser.read_page or eludite.browser.find in the current page generation.

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
